The independent development-only C# recipe in ../reference/set-interface.cs executes genuine Framework ISet<int>, HashSet<int> and a complete tracing user ISet implementation. Its 3168 outcomes cover every inherited/own operation and HashSet construction from the interface, ordinary and modulo-three comparers, empty/populated sets, present/absent/equivalent elements, nil receivers, array inputs with overlaps/duplicates, nil inputs, self inputs and copy bounds. Callbacks and enumeration order are recorded through the actual interfaces. The native test executes all outcomes against both direct ISet and a named interface inheriting ISet.

The visible ISet contract has eighteen slots: Count, IsReadOnly, Clear, Contains, CopyTo, Remove, GetEnumerator, boolean Add, ExceptWith, IntersectWith, IsProperSubsetOf, IsProperSupersetOf, IsSubsetOf, IsSupersetOf, Overlaps, SetEquals, SymmetricExceptWith and UnionWith. The boolean Add hides the inherited procedure; an ICollection<T> upcast retains its distinct eight-slot contract. A user class supplies that procedure explicitly. Native HashSet adapters share the existing storage, comparer, mutation version and sequence algorithms; the runtime does not select methods by name.

Regenerate with ../reference/generate-set-interface.ps1. Columns are implementation, comparer, initial size, nil receiver, operation, element, input choice, copy offset, UTF-16 hexadecimal stdout (- means empty), and error code. Argument/receiver nil maps to E_NIL, copy bounds to E_RANGE, and invalidated enumerators to E_MODIFIED. JSON hashes normalize CRLF to LF. Additional native cases check Add result typing, aliases and checked casts, self operations, type names and malformed metadata. These are compatibility cases, not complete API coverage or completion of PABCSystem, Collections, source-unit loading, record interfaces, general exceptions or the full library.
